Use case: stylized-concept. NEW original KFB cartoon claymation ink blob CAREER LEVEL TRIPLETS, ordinary occupations not RPG costumes. Input1 ORIGINAL freche-family: whole dark goo morphology/material reference. Input2 ORIGINAL professions sheet: modeled props/material craft ONLY. Actual STYLE REFERENCE images, NOT edit targets; invent new identities, no reference face clones, no prior RPG monsters/outfits.
ONE landscape1536x1024 TRUE TRANSPARENT PNG. EXACTLY THREE columns and TWO rows = SIX complete standalone ink figures. EACH ROW one unique recognizable identity shown through THREE career stages LEFT starter, MIDDLE practitioner, RIGHT senior. Keep fixed silhouette family, teeth/quirk/colour signature across row; change acting, professional tools and restrained status cues. Similar body height across all, senior does NOT mean giant/human boss. Each row one gender identity repeated3times; two identities per sheet.
CRITICAL COMPOSITION: equal512x512 CELLS, each entire figure incl props/droplets fits a MAX384x384 box with at least64px clear transparent margins ALL sides. Centres(256,256),(768,256),(1280,256),(256,768),(768,768),(1280,768). Never cross x512,x1024,y512; don't fill canvas with huge subjects. No overlaps/crops. Keep all props low near own belly.
FAMILY: COMPLETE upright facing camera/front3quarter continuous charcoal-black ink SPLAT, subtle rich violet sheen, thick soft asymmetrical round goo lobes; hands goo attached to body. FOOTLESS, NO legs/feet, no human bust/cut torso. Visible ink body dominant, clothes small collars/caps/accessories, not full coats/robes hiding goo. Rich smooth hand-modeled plasticine, fingerprints, softly rounded material volumes not faceted/gritty. Sculpted expressive lids/lips; uneven ivory teeth. EVERY open eye has WHITE/ivory sclera around distinct RED iris and BLACK pupil. No glowing/all-red eyeballs. NO generic Pixar baby sweetness, same angry V-brow smile template or random gross anatomy. Distinct acting strongest moment; vary emotion trajectories between rows, not every left afraid/middle angry/right smug. Few FUNCTIONAL iconic props, fat simple readable craft volumes; no busy machines or pun labels.

TOP ROW, FEMALE-READ MEDIZIN. Fixed signature ALL THREE: upright tall bent pear-shaped charcoal-violet ink splat, split curling crown tuft, soft lashes, ONE broad upper ivory tooth and one offset little lower fang. Tiny ivory coat-LAPEL COLLAR only with small TEAL cloth tab, no human coat torso.
LEFT Medizinstudentin: Concentrated lopsided squint, biting thick lower lip, other white/red/black eye looks down. Holds ONE little blank worn ivory medical notebook and ONE short thick wooden reflex hammer with soft rubber head. No stethoscope yet.
MIDDLE Ärztin: Brisk reassuring asymmetric open tooth smile, unequal alert eyes toward viewer. Same teal tab/collar/quiff/teeth. Holds ONE properly formed compact STETHOSCOPE with TWO distinct eartips on a U-shaped metal binaural piece, connected tubes merging into ONE short curved tube and ONE round chestpiece. Compact recognizable single object at belly, no tangled tubing.
RIGHT Chefärztin / Professorin: Drained professorial sideways half-lids, long CLOSED downturned thick lip with single upper tooth peeking, no tongue/grin. SAME identity and tiny coat collar, one little brass round head mirror on thin band. One hand holds SAME compact correctly formed stethoscope, other hugs ONE fat closed ivory book with plain brass clasp. Similar body size, tools not a pile.

BOTTOM ROW, male PFLEGE. Fixed signature ALL THREE: broad low but UPRIGHT rounded bell ink blob, three uneven crown nubs, tiny moss-green scrub cap with mustard stitched patch and short cream collar, TWO big uneven lower teeth, no human uniform body.
LEFT Pflegeschüler: Alarmed wide unequal eyes, crooked open underbite, holds ONE large ivory bandage roll awkwardly against own goo belly, loose end short and fully contained.
MIDDLE Pflegefachkraft: Fearlessly stern side gaze, clenched irregular lower teeth and arched ONE brow. Same green cap/patch/teeth. Holds ONE small red-brown leather care case with a thick plain ivory bandage-shaped patch, and SAME bandage roll in a little front loop.
RIGHT Stationsleiter: Calm exhausted one-eye-heavy side stare, CLOSED sideways compressed underbite. Same small cap/patch, tiny brass collar pin. Hugs SAME small care case and holds ONE compact ring of THREE fat brass ward keys, no chart/bed/scene.
EMPTY SPACE AND HOLES: alpha0 genuinely transparent, figures opaque, soft edge antialias only. No coloured backdrop/gradient/floor/shadowdisc/environment/scenery/checkerboard/labels/text/logos/numbers/floating punctuation. No scenelets or diagrams. Don't write names/stages. EXACT SIX full ink blobs, two row identities, three visibly different CAREER levels each. NO protruding tongue in ANY cell, especially bottom-right; strong sculpted lips instead. Keep accessories physically understandable; no extra gear, tools only as specified. Maximal personality and offbeat satirical handmade clay appeal.
